run_train_model_tf: run the glassy dynamics training script using TensorFlow to predict particle mobilities in glasses
run_train_model_jax: run the glassy dynamics training script using JAX to predict particle mobilities in glasses
run_train_with_checkpoint: run the training script with a checkpoint path to save the best model
run_train_with_time_index: run the training script with a custom time index for target mobilities
run_train_with_max_files: run the training script limiting the number of files loaded from datasets
